{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of missing age (-1) across customer_segment
missing_age_by_segment = completed_df[completed_df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print('Missing age (-1) by customer_segment:')
print(missing_age_by_segment)

# Total segments
segment_counts = completed_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print('\nTotal completed orders by segment:')
print(segment_counts)

# Check if missingness is balanced
missing_rate_by_segment = completed_df.groupby('customer_segment')['customer_age'].apply(lambda x: (x == -1).mean()) * 100
print('\nMissing age rate by segment (%):')
print(missing_rate_by_segment)"}
